title: Printed RFID Cards
description: Custom printed RFID cards with full-color graphics, barcodes, magnetic stripes and chip encoding for hotel, access, membership and event programs.
summary: Printed RFID cards combine full-color card printing with embedded contactless chips for ready-to-issue hotel keys, staff IDs, membership cards and event credentials.
Accurate color matching: Top quality offset printing machine, and experienced printing stuff guarantee to reproduce your artwork more vividly.
Tidy card edge: Top punching mold guarantee that the card edge is very neat.
